messages.content: I reviewed the Koloa Bay confirmation again. It shows breakfast for one guest, although the reservation is for two, and the parking language does not tell me whether both June 10 and June 17 are covered. Please reconcile that with the offer we booked before the refundable deadline.

I’ll compare confirmation KB8F41 with the booked offer and ask the resort to clarify both inclusions in writing. For parking, I’ll verify the exact covered dates and whether checkout-day access produces any separate charge.
Good. Breakfast needs to be for both of us every day it is served during the stay. I do not want to arrive and find that the second breakfast is extra.

The booked offer specifies daily breakfast for two registered guests. The resort has acknowledged that the confirmation populated the package field incorrectly as one guest; it is correcting that field rather than changing the rate.
And what did they say about parking? We will collect the car at the airport on arrival and return it after checking out on June 17.

The resort confirmed that self-parking is included for the full seven-night reservation, beginning when you arrive on June 10 and continuing through your departure on June 17. There is no separate arrival-day, checkout-day, or overnight parking charge for the reserved car.
Please have them issue a revised confirmation showing both items. Do not change the trip total unless they identify an actual additional charge.

The updated confirmation for KB8F41 has been issued. It now states daily breakfast for two on all seven mornings, June 11 through June 17, and complimentary self-parking from arrival on June 10 through departure on June 17. The resort confirmed that both were included in the booked offer and added no charge, so the resort total remains $4,447.97 and the projected vacation total remains $6,475.73. The June 3 at 6:00 p.m. Hawaii time refundable deadline is unchanged.
